messages.subject: Lunchtime CPD: PD 57AD disclosure in practice — 15 May
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello all,

A reminder that the litigation group's lunchtime CPD on Practice Direction 57AD (Disclosure in the Business and Property Courts) is on 15 May, 12:30-13:30 in the Bishopsgate room. Sandwiches provided. One CPD hour. Please reply if attending so we can cater.

Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant | Whitfield Carter LLP
